source.check: Returning Officer's Notice of Result (Ulster Herald, 31 May 1958, p. 5): the name is entered in column 6 for this division, no poll being needed; read from the INA OCR in division order, and agreeing with the Strabane Chronicle's list of nominations (24 May 1958, p. 3)

note: Triennial election of the rural district councillors, polled Thursday 5 June 1958. There was no election: ten Unionists and six Nationalists were nominated (Belfast News-Letter, 21 May 1958, p. 11). All sixteen members are recorded from the Returning Officer's Notice of Result (Ulster Herald, 31 May 1958, p. 5), which agrees with the Strabane Chronicle's list of the nominations (24 May 1958, p. 3). The Strabane Chronicle's list prints 'Robert K. Henderson' (Mr. R. K. Henderson, chairman of Omagh Urban Council), in place of Mr. George Robinson. Returned unopposed.
